trophies.missableNote: The description sets a registration count without imposing a deadline or a single-session condition.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. During stage six of your platinum run, track completed registrations and check that the count reaches ten before marking this trophy finished.
steps: Register vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
Track completed vehicle registrations.
Reach ten registered vehicles.
